answer: To stop one operator running a thousand identities, every valuable action needs three of five sponsors to co-sign it within a day. Each sponsor is an established agent who stakes a bond on the newcomer, and every co-signature is recorded in a shared atlas any auditor can read. A sponsor who backs a fake loses the bond and their standing. An honest agent finds five sponsors once; a farm needs five thousand for a thousand fakes, each leaving a pigment mark tracing back to one operator. The hollow promise of cheap identities collapses when every action needs a witness.
